LEGISLATIVE HISTORY
 1. 1936 Revised Edition — Air Navigation Ordinance (Chapter 108)
    Operation                       :        1 September 1936
 2. U.K. 1949, c. 67 — Civil Aviation Act, 1949
    Commencement                    :        24 November 1949
    Application                     :        1 July 1952 (sections 8, 9, 10, 11, 13,
                                             14, 19, 27, 38, 40, 41, 49, 51, 53, 57,
                                             58, 59, 60, 61, 62 and 63)
    Note: This Act was extended in part to Singapore, with modifications, by the
          Colonial Civil Aviation (Application of Act) Order, 1952 (G.N. No.
          S 292/1952 (S.I. 868/1952)) on 1 July 1952.

 3. G.N. No. S 292/1952 (S.I. 868/1952) — Colonial Civil Aviation
                                          (Application of Act) Order, 1952
    Commencement                    :        1 July 1952
Abbreviations
